svg.aria-label: The system map: Deimos at the core; Clockford, Ratchet, Crimp, Marklode and M.A.X in orbit; four rules around the edge.

text.textPath: PEOPLE STAY IN CHARGE OF WHAT MATTERS ✦ ASSUME SOMETHING IS ALREADY INSIDE ✦ IF IT MATTERS, MAKE IT PROVABLE ✦ BEND, DON’T BREAK ✦ PEOPLE STAY IN CHARGE OF WHAT MATTERS ✦ ASSUME SOMETHING IS ALREADY INSIDE ✦ IF IT MATTERS, MAKE IT PROVABLE ✦ BEND, DON’T BREAK ✦

svg.text: see · approve · stop your AI agents from your phone
every real-world effect, at most once
decisions that withdraw themselves when a fact breaks
diligence before the pitch, in 24 to 72 hours
behavior, read against each person’s own baseline
